name: artifen
description: Build and host sites on Artifen, from one HTML page to a full-stack app with a database, sign-in, files, email, AI, and payments. Bundles the Artifen skill and connects the Artifen MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Put what you build online as a site
interface.longDescription: Artifen hosts whatever your AI builds, from one HTML page to a full-stack app with a database, sign-in, files, email, AI, and payments, each at its own address. With this plugin, your AI can create a site in one of your workspaces, change its files, check each build, publish its preview, go back to an earlier version, and read its logs, data, and comments. A new site opens only for the people you invite, and you choose who else can open it in the Artifen app.
